title: UI System
summary: Repo overview of the brand-agnostic UI System: one ui.config.json drives tokens, components, navs and Claude Design output; covers setup, controls, plugin, commands and sync workflow.
scope: config controls (color, radius, type, density, surface, brand, avatars, motion, nav)
frontend navs (NavIsland, NavBar, NavStacked, NavDock, NavMinimal, NavMobile)

notes: Root README: onboarding/overview prose with quick-start steps. Mild SPEC signal from the controls table (config keys, allowed values, effects) but it summarises and defers to docs/config.md as the full reference, so DOC. Embedded rules (WCAG 4.5:1 text roles, never stock photos, packages are source of truth) are context worth surfacing. Filename hash suffix is a placeholder (root0000): no hashing tool was available to compute SHA-256 of the source path; follows sibling convention.
